mapper.sql: id, title, content, type, target_type, target_ids, publisher_id, is_top, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM announcement WHERE type = 1 AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT FROM announcement WHERE type = 2 AND status = 1 AND (target_type = 0 OR (target_type = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, target_ids)) OR (target_type = 2 AND #{vipLevel} IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{vipLevel}, target_ids))) ORDER BY is_top DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN announcement_read r ON a.id = r.announcement_id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.type = 2 AND a.status = 1 AND (a.target_type = 0 OR (a.target_type = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, a.target_ids)) OR (a.target_type = 2 AND #{vipLevel} IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{vipLevel}, a.target_ids))) AND r.id IS NULL
